lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible across the primary torso. Spacing is wider on the anterior flank and becomes progressively narrower and tighter towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior lines at the shoulder are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-ventral line. The 8th and 9th lines appear as dashed or broken segments near the dorsal region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral posterior haunch; one larger primary blob is positioned superior to a smaller secondary blob.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, curving backward and outward from the skull base before arcing forward and inward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the distal 15-20% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal mane extends from the shoulder to the rump. Significant white fringe hair is visible on the ventral neck and chest. White 'sock' markings are visible on the lower limbs above the fetlock.
